$comment: Hand-written English meanings for the legacy procedure family (retiring under REG-342) and a few remaining inline keys of docs/DSL_KEYWORD_REFERENCE.md. See meanings-concept.json for the file format.

slots.autoPanelSurface.dataSource: Replaces the generated row source of a selection surface (see `autoPanelDataSource`).
slots.workbenchAction.applyTo: Folds the procedure's result into the draft as a new row of a collection.
slots.transactionUiState.label: Caption of the control that changes the state.

inline.conversion.javaHook.source: Source-root path of the Java class, in the same shape a mounted code extension uses.
inline.conversion.javaHook.class: Fully qualified name of the class.
inline.conversion.javaHook.method: Name of the method that performs the conversion.
inline.experience.navigation.label: Caption of the navigation entry.
inline.experience.navigation.screen: Name of the screen the entry opens.
inline.httpConnectorOperation.response.pointer: JSON pointer (for example `/data/id`) of the value to return; absent returns the whole body.
inline.localizableLabel.default: The text used when the requested locale and its language have no entry. Other keys are locale tags such as `pt-BR`.
inline.panelWidget.filter.field: Field of the data source to compare.
inline.panelWidget.filter.equals: Only rows whose field equals this text are aggregated.
